answer: WITH m AS ( SELECT zoneref, (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr, (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res, (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom FROM mesh ), mm AS ( SELECT *, (mcr > 5.0 AND res < 1.0 AND geom < 0.5) AS is_hf FROM m ) SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, COUNT(mm.zoneref) AS total_meshes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mm.is_hf) AS high_fidelity_meshes, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mm.is_hf) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(mm.zoneref), 0), 2) AS high_fidelity_percentage, ROUND(AVG(mm.mcr), 2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(AVG(mm.res), 2) AS avg_mesh_resolution_mm, ROUND(AVG(mm.geom), 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mm.is_hf) > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes' WHEN COUNT(mm.zoneref) > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality' ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification FROM sites s LEFT JOIN mm ON mm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel ORDER BY high_fidelity_percentage DESC NULLS LAST

WITH r AS ( SELECT g.logregistry, g.arcref, (g.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc, (g.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err, g.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS method, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res FROM registration g JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = g.arcref AND p.crewref = g.crewref ), x AS ( SELECT *, res / (acc * sqrt(1 + err / acc)) AS rar FROM r ) SELECT logregistry AS registration_id, arcref AS project_id, acc AS registration_accuracy_mm, err AS error_value_mm, ROUND(rar, 2) AS rar, CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND method LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence' WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence' ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level FROM x ORDER BY rar DESC

WITH e AS ( SELECT zoneref, 100 - 2.5 * ABS((ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20) - power(ABS(((ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50) / 2), 1.5) - 600 / ((ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100) AS esi FROM environment ) SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(e.esi), 2) AS avg_esi FROM sites s JOIN e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, c.structstate AS structural_state, s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status, CASE WHEN (s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Poor%' OR s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Critical%') AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%' THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category FROM sites s JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
note: Returns every site-conservation record with its category; if only risk-zone sites are wanted, add a WHERE on the same condition.

answer: WITH pc AS ( SELECT s.zoneref, s.arcref, s.crewref, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pd, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref ), pcm AS ( SELECT zoneref, arcref, crewref, res, noise, cov * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cov / 100)) AS sce, power(10 / (log(res * 1000) / log(pd) * 5), 1.5) * (cov * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cov / 100)) / 100) * power(1 - noise / 30, 2) AS sqs FROM pc ), pc_site AS ( SELECT zoneref, AVG(sqs) AS sqs, AVG(sce) AS sce, AVG(noise) AS noise FROM pcm GROUP BY zoneref ), reg_site AS ( SELECT pcm.zoneref, AVG(pcm.res / ((g.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric * sqrt(1 + (g.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric / (g.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric))) AS rar, AVG(sqrt((g.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric / pcm.res)) AS err_term FROM pcm JOIN registration g ON g.arcref = pcm.arcref AND g.crewref = pcm.crewref GROUP BY pcm.zoneref ), mesh_site AS ( SELECT zoneref, AVG( ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000) * (((mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric / (sqrt((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric) * (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric) * 0.01) / 10) * (1 + exp(-(mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric)) ) AS mfs FROM mesh GROUP BY zoneref ) SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(0.3 * (0.4 * p.sqs + 0.4 * m.mfs + 0.2 * p.sce - 5 * sqrt(p.noise / 10)) + 0.3 * m.mfs + 0.2 * r.rar + 0.2 * p.sce - 2 * r.err_term, 2) AS dpq FROM sites s JOIN pc_site p ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry JOIN mesh_site m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry JOIN reg_site r ON r.zoneref = s.zoneregistry ORDER BY dpq DESC

WITH pc AS ( SELECT s.zoneref, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cd, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric / ((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric * (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::numeric) AS pcdr FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref ), fe AS ( SELECT pc.zoneref, ((f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::numeric + (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::numeric) / (pc.pcdr * sqrt(pc.cd)) * 1000 AS fee FROM pc JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = pc.zoneref ), pc_site AS ( SELECT zoneref, AVG(pcdr) AS avg_pcdr FROM pc GROUP BY zoneref ), fe_site AS ( SELECT zoneref, AVG(fee) AS avg_fee FROM fe GROUP BY zoneref ) SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, ROUND(p.avg_pcdr, 2) AS avg_pcdr, ROUND(f.avg_fee, 2) AS avg_fee FROM sites s LEFT JOIN pc_site p ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry LEFT JOIN fe_site f ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST

WITH pr AS ( SELECT p.flowregistry, p.zoneref, p.flowstage, CASE WHEN lower(p.flowsoft) IN ('realitycapture', 'reality capture', 'rc', 'r.c.') THEN 'RealityCapture' WHEN lower(p.flowsoft) IN ('agisoft', 'agisoft metashape', 'metashape', 'agi', 'agi.') THEN 'Agisoft' WHEN lower(p.flowsoft) IN ('geomagic', 'geomagic studio', 'geo', 'geo.') THEN 'Geomagic' WHEN lower(p.flowsoft) IN ('cloudcompare', 'cloud compare', 'cc', 'c.c.') THEN 'CloudCompare' ELSE NULLIF(btrim(p.flowsoft), '') END AS software, (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs, (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu, (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu FROM processing p ), j AS ( SELECT pr.*, split_part(s.size, ' ', 1)::numeric AS size_gb, (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS total_pts FROM pr JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pr.zoneref JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref ), agg AS ( SELECT software, flowstage, AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu, AVG(size_gb) AS avg_size, AVG(size_gb * log(total_pts) / (hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200)) AS avg_per, COUNT(DISTINCT flowregistry) AS workflow_count FROM j GROUP BY software, flowstage ) SELECT software, flowstage AS stage, ROUND(avg_hrs, 1) AS avg_processing_hours, ROUND(avg_cpu, 1) AS avg_cpu_usage, ROUND(avg_gpu, 1) AS avg_gpu_usage, ROUND(avg_size, 1) AS avg_data_size_gb, ROUND(avg_per, 1) AS avg_per, CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status, workflow_count FROM agg ORDER BY efficiency_status, avg_per ASC
note: Software names normalised to four canonical names (empty string -> NULL); file size and total points linked via scans (zoneref) and pointcloud (arcref+crewref).

answer: WITH e AS ( SELECT zoneref, (ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric AS temp, (ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric AS hum, (ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric AS lux FROM environment ), agg AS ( SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, AVG(e.temp) AS avg_temp, AVG(e.hum) AS avg_hum, AVG(e.lux) AS avg_lux, AVG(100 - 2.5 * ABS(e.temp - 20) - power(ABS((e.hum - 50) / 2), 1.5) - 600 / (e.lux + 100)) AS avg_esi FROM sites s JOIN e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel ) SELECT site_code, site_name, ROUND(avg_temp, 1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(avg_hum, 1) AS avg_humidity, ROUND(avg_lux, 1) AS avg_illumination, ROUND(avg_esi, 1) AS avg_esi, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS esi_quartile, CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions' WHEN avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions' WHEN avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions' ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition_class FROM agg ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

WITH m AS ( SELECT s.zoneref, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pd, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref ), q AS ( SELECT zoneref, power(10 / (log(res * 1000) / log(pd) * 5), 1.5) * (cov * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cov / 100)) / 100) * power(1 - noise / 30, 2) AS sqs FROM m ) SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(q.sqs), 2) AS avg_sqs FROM sites si JOIN q ON q.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC

WITH j AS ( SELECT p.equipref, (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs, (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu, (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu, split_part(s.size, ' ', 1)::numeric AS size_gb, (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts FROM processing p LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = p.zoneref AND m.equipref = p.equipref ), agg AS ( SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_id, AVG(j.hrs * (j.cpu + j.gpu) / 2 / (j.size_gb * 10 * log(j.verts + 10000))) AS pru, AVG(j.hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(j.cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(j.gpu) AS avg_gpu FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN j ON j.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry ) SELECT equipment_id, ROUND(pru, 2) AS pru, ROUND(avg_hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST) AS efficiency_rank, CASE WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized' WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable' ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_efficiency_status, jsonb_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(avg_cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(avg_gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(avg_hrs, 2)) AS resource_details FROM agg ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST
